tech.summary: Samsung Electronics said its operating profit rose nearly ninefold year-on-year to a record high in the third quarter, driven by robust demand for AI chips, even as investors stayed cautious about how durable AI spending will be. Rival SK Hynix also reported strong earnings, and Samsung said the chip supply shortage would deepen next year.
tech.title: Samsung posts record Q3 profit on AI chip boom

tech.summary: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering and expand work on Muse, Meta's personal AI agent, while Meta widens its use of Nvidia's Vera Rubin systems and networking tech. The investment sits inside Meta's $97.5 billion offering — the largest fundraising in its history — to pay for AI infrastructure; AMD committed $1 billion alongside Nvidia.
tech.title: Nvidia invests $3B in Meta's record $97.5B equity offering

tech.summary: Seoul-based AI chip startup FuriosaAI closed a $620 million Series D at a $2.9 billion valuation, roughly four times its early-2025 mark. South Korea's National Growth Fund led with $280 million; FuriosaAI began mass-producing its RNGD inference chip in January and plans to scale TSMC production from 20,000 chips this year to over 40,000 in 2027.
tech.title: FuriosaAI raises $620M at $2.9B valuation for AI inference chips

tech.summary: LG Uplus said two of its papers on AI token optimization were accepted for the On-Device Intelligence Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 in Sydney. Applied to smartphones, the tech delivered roughly 4.5x faster processing and about 77% lower battery use than conventional methods, while keeping performance on par with cloud-based AI.
tech.title: LG Uplus token-optimization papers accepted at NeurIPS 2026

tech.summary: Cognite announced that companies using its Industrial AI and Data Platform have unlocked more than $1 billion in verified, realized value, one year after launching its $100 billion Moonshot goal for 2035. About 36% of the value came from cutting unplanned downtime, 27% from frontline productivity and 26% from higher production.
tech.title: Cognite says customers unlocked $1B in verified industrial AI value

tech.summary: Casap closed a $56 million Series B led by Base10 Partners, with strategic checks from Experian and Synchrony, bringing total funding to about $90 million since its 2023 launch. Its AI agents handle bank disputes, chargebacks and fraud end-to-end for 100+ financial institutions, reporting 51% fraud-loss cuts and 73% of cases resolved with no human touch.
tech.title: Casap raises $56M to grow AI agents for bank disputes and fraud

pakistan.summary: The federal government increased petrol by Rs1.85 per litre to Rs377.91 and high-speed diesel by Rs1.75 to Rs399.82, effective October 29, under the daily pricing mechanism. The move follows a petrol cut of Rs3.19 a day earlier, and comes as global crude rose about 2% on fighting in Yemen and an attack on a Saudi refinery.
pakistan.title: Petrol up Rs1.85, diesel up Rs1.75 from today

pakistan.summary: The Pak International Business Forum warned that the State Bank's decision to raise the policy rate from 11.5% to 12% will raise borrowing costs, squeeze production and discourage investment, with SMEs hit hardest. It said controlling inflation matters, but monetary policy must also protect growth, investment and jobs.
pakistan.title: Business forum warns rate hike to 12% will hurt industry

pakistan.summary: Pakistan imported over 4.5 gigawatts of battery storage equipment in the first six months of 2026 alone — nearly half its entire cumulative historical imports of 9.5GW. At a parliamentary dialogue, lawmakers warned against substandard imports, while the Power Division promised pilot storage tenders and NEPRA designation of storage as a regulated asset.
pakistan.title: Pakistan imported 4.5GW of battery storage gear in six months

pakistan.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif directed ministries to complete by November all necessary measures for projects with Alibaba Group covering AI, digitalisation, exports and public services. The agenda includes an AI training programme for IT graduates, an early cancer detection system, OGRA fuel-supply analytics and help for SMEs reaching global markets.
pakistan.title: PM orders Alibaba AI, digitalisation projects wrapped up by November

pakistan.summary: Pakistan batting coach Mike Smith conceded the batting unit is operating at only about 70% of its potential after the hosts were bowled out for 110 in 25.3 overs and crushed by eight wickets by Sri Lanka in the ODI tri-series at Gaddafi Stadium. Sri Lanka's Dilshan Madushanka took a career-best five for 34; the sides meet again in Saturday's final.
pakistan.title: Batting coach admits Pakistan at '70 per cent' after Sri Lanka rout

pakistan.summary: Kashmir Black Day was observed in Rawalpindi, Murree and elsewhere with rallies, seminars, solidarity walks and photo exhibitions condemning India's occupation of Jammu and Kashmir and backing Kashmiris' right to self-determination. Students presented tableaus and songs, a minute's silence was observed, and speakers called for sustained international attention.
pakistan.title: Kashmir Black Day marked with rallies and seminars
